verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence close to a sandbox is the Free plan, a new account pitched for building, breaking things and experimenting with no charges. CloudFormation stacks can also be created and deleted wholesale, which supports throwaway environments. Neither is documented as a test environment isolated from production data; CloudFormation and IAM are general building blocks rather than a sandbox feature. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment feature, explicit isolation of production data, guidance on separate dev/test accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
